notes: Completed job application form, one page. Furniture: the organisation band at the top ('Brightwater County Library Service', 'Human Resources · Confidential when completed') and the footer line (form number, 'Page 1 of 1'). Section bars 'Section A – …' to 'Section F – …' are level-2 headings. Form labels are not headings. Each section's fields form a ruled table: Sections A, B, E and F are key/value grids without a header row (label cells shaded, filled-in values in Courier New); the address and e-mail values span three columns and are repeated. Sections C and D are tables with a header row. Cells of two lines are joined with one space. In Section E the answer cell shows 'Yes' and 'No' with two CSS-drawn check boxes (the 'No' box is filled); the boxes are not characters, so the cell text is 'Yes No'. The notes list uses TYPED lower-roman markers '(i)', '(ii)', '(iii)' with a hanging indent.
